S0337.reason: The P-value is the probability of observing a test statistic as extreme or more extreme than the one observed under the null hypothesis. In this case, we are testing H0: p=0.3 against HA: p>0.3 and found a test statistic of 0.35. Since the P-value is the area to the right of 0.35 on the z-distribution, it can be calculated as 1 - P(Z<0.35) = 1 - 0.6209 = 0.1446.
